title: LMS-NG MQTT delivery ack v2
description: Published Server -> Gateway to delivery/acks/{gatewayId}, QoS1, not retained. This is NOT a lift command -- it is the application-level acknowledgement that a durable telemetry record reached DB_COMMITTED, sent only after the SQL transaction actually commits (revised plan section A.5, the plan's headline fix per [T1]: MQTT PUBACK is a transport-layer peer acknowledgement, not a database guarantee). Only the Server principal may publish here (ACL, test I12: a spoofed ack from any other principal must not be able to clear a Gateway's outbox).

result.description: The four REJECTED_* values are NACKs -- they mean the original message was NOT considered delivered and the Gateway must not clear it from its outbox on receipt of one of these; it goes to a dead-letter/quarantine state instead (revised plan section A.5).

targetMessageId.description: The messageId of the record this ack/nack refers to.

targetPayloadHash.description: Hash of the original payload the Gateway sent, echoed back so the Gateway can confirm this ack matches the exact bytes it retried, not an earlier/different record under the same identity (guards against the identity/payload-conflict case, test I08).

serverDataEpoch.description: The Backend's current data epoch identifier. Changes only after an approved restore-from-backup runbook (revised plan section A.5/C.6) -- present so a Gateway can detect it is talking to a server that just underwent a restore.
